---
title: "All exercises & code"
subtitle: "Twenty worked R walkthroughs and seven downloadable projects"
---

Each **application exercise** is a rendered R walkthrough: read it in the
browser to see the code and its output together. Each one also ships inside a
**project bundle** — an RStudio project with the data already in place, so you
can open it and run the same code yourself.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="simple"}
## How to work through these

1.  Read the rendered walkthrough in the browser to see where you are heading.
2.  Download the matching bundle and open the `.Rproj` file in RStudio.
3.  Work through the `.Rmd` yourself — the blanks (`______`) are for you to fill.
4.  Compare against the solutions where they are provided.
:::
